article.title: Privatization in Sandy Springs, Georgia
article.excerpt: Cities have dabbled for years with privatization, but few have taken the idea as far as Sandy Springs . Since the day it incorporated, Dec. 1, 2005, it has handed off to private enterprise just about every service that can be evaluated through metrics and inked into a contract.
